_comment: bromigOS Server, the edition with no desktop. The installer reads /usr/share/bromigos/editions/server.json first (the bromigos-server package's, the Field Kit job's), then this one. Fields: id, title, summary, hint, desktop (false: no desktop steps, splash, bromigos install/setup), meta (the meta package: when it's on the medium it is the whole package set, in place of packages), packages (this stand-in's set until the meta package ships; the boot, disk and snapshot packages are always added), services, check_packages (what must be on the medium for an offline install), download_size, auto_update_units (systemd units the Automatic updates choice enables when the system has them). docs/iso.md, "Editions".
title: bromigOS Server
summary: No desktop, for servers and lab machines: a text console, SSH, the lab console, and updates with snapshots.
hint: For a computer that runs on its own, often without a screen. You manage it at its console or from another computer.
